stem: An irrigation SOP requires the technician to verify a reading, but there is no field anywhere to record the value. What does this indicate?
choices: The technician should rely on memory until the end of the week
The procedure and record design are incomplete for that required observation
The reading is not important if the crop looks healthy
The technician should invent a private shorthand and avoid mentioning the problem
rationale: Critical observations and decisions should have a defined record location. If the procedure requires a value but provides no way to record it, the execution/record system is incomplete.
